config.label: Path to the SQLite store
config.description: Path to the SQLite store. Defaults to a fixed per-user data directory; set this to isolate a store.

config.label: Browser viewer on loopback
config.description: Browser viewer on loopback. On by default; set to 0 to turn it off.

config.label: Set to 1 to also expose one open_<name> tool per saved app
config.description: Set to 1 to also expose one open_<name> tool per saved app. Off by default, because it costs prompt cache.
